name: s81ph-dsfd_colt_lane-ring-e96dd1e56-tc-hm10-g12
purpose: Structural ring output FIFO: unchanged SRAM/II2/output capacity/latency, replaces 512-bit OBD4 shift with circular pointers. Model record results/rtl/s81_colt_ring_20261008/model.json. Default off until cycle exactness and real TT/FF closure. Prior g12 LVT TT -3.49 / FF -1.26 / SS sensitivity -165.3, DRC0; preserve historical verdict.

calibrate.cmd: export OT_MULTI_VT=lvt; export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_ph_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; HM=0.01 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv' MACROS='ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2=physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2' PDN=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pdn_tile_sym.tcl SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/colt_lane_mcp.sdc CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {NAME}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_colt_lane rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_col_tile.sv --orfs-var MACRO_PLACEMENT_TCL=/src/physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/place_macros_tile_g12.tcl $CL_STOP_AFTER --param RING=1

route.cmd: export OT_MULTI_VT=lvt; export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/make_io_vclk_margin.sh ${CK_SS_MEAN} >/dev/null && export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_ph_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; SDCM=physical/s81_ph_views/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN}.sdc HM=0.01 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv' MACROS='ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2=physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2' PDN=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pdn_tile_sym.tcl SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/colt_lane_mcp.sdc CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {NAME}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_colt_lane rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_col_tile.sv --orfs-var MACRO_PLACEMENT_TCL=/src/physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/place_macros_tile_g12.tcl $CL_STOP_AFTER --param RING=1

budget.reason: S81-PH tile sheet is grade 'target' (no calibration); the tiles' measured insertion (~250 ps) is far below it, so the sheet SDC would put vclk hundreds of ps late (output hold model -> mass hold buffering). Routed on the calibrated MEASURED insertion (STANDARD FLOW); calib.json in the record for the sheet re-plan.
